The '''Laseltshen Independence War''' was a military and political event that allowed the [[emancipation]] of [[Laselteh]] from [[Estijan Huan]], ending the [[Colonial Laselteh|colonial period]] and initiating the formation of an independent republic.

It developed in the context of the [[East Atirhan wars of independence]], a military and political process that began after the Etirhan revolution in 1641 in the [[Merelan colonies]]. In response to the capture of [[Suvrana]] by [[Etirhan patriot forces]] in 1644, The [[Government Junta of Laselteh (1644)|First Government Junta of Laselteh]] was formed for that purpose. But then, it began to gradually radicalise, which caused a military struggle between [[pro and anti-independence advocates]] who were looking for a definitive separation from the [[Estijan Huan Crown|Huan Crown]]; and [[Royalist (Laselteh Revolution)|Royalists]], who sought to maintain unity with it. 

Traditionally, Laseltshen historiography covers this period between the establishment of the [[First Government Junta of Laselte]]<nowiki/>h (May 12, 1644) and the resignation of [[Azraniel Barque]] as [[Supreme Director of Laselteh]], replaced by [[Tyidai Idueria]]. Laseltshen rebels lead a [[guerrilla campaign]] in the sparsely populated forests against Huan loyalists, further away from the coast. In 1645 [[Etirha]] began supplying the rebels with help from [[Emara]] through their shared border. The Laseltshen captured the capital of Estijan power in [[Atirha]], [[Dariya]], in November 1646. The war itself began in 1644 and lasted until the start of 1667, when the last royalist forces were defeated in [[Zayden]] in January and in [[Dalbiqan]] in February. 

A [[Laseltshen Declaration of Independence|declaration of independence]] was officially issued by Laselteh on 5 February 1647, and formally recognised by [[Estijan Huan]] in 3 December 1649, when full diplomatic relations were established.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.worldstatesmen.andah.org/Laselteh.html|title=Laselteh|publisher=World Statesmen}}</ref>
